title: Not All Subjectivity Is the Same! Defining Desiderata for the Evaluation of Subjectivity in NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying evaluation metrics (such as the Value Inequity Index and linear mixed-effects models) that measure the absolute difference or similarity between a model's default predictions and the human ratings of specific demographic groups.

Reviewing practices that use distance and reliability metrics to evaluate whether a model's outputs minimize bias toward dominant (e.g., Western) perspectives and adequately represent minority and diverse cultural viewpoints.
